facts.text: Philippe Starck redesigned the hotel for La Réserve.
facts.excerpt: Unique and elegant, the legendary hotel is reborn, after several months of an ambitious undertaking nurtured by the creativity of Philippe Starck

facts.text: Philippe Starck says the design was inspired by an imaginary yacht club.
facts.excerpt: designer Philippe Starck claims to have been inspired by “an imaginary yacht club.”

facts.text: The Eden au Lac has been a Zurich institution since 1909.
facts.excerpt: The Eden au Lac has been a Zürich institution since 1909

facts.text: The hotel reopened as part of Michel Reybier's La Réserve portfolio.
facts.excerpt: reopened as part of Michel Reybier’s La Réserve portfolio

facts.text: The Utoquai bathing area on Lake Zurich is just in front of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: sunbathing at one of the region’s typical badis (bathing areas), such as Utoquai. Located just in front of the La Réserve Eden au Lac Zurich

facts.text: Arrival by car is via Kreuzstrasse, where the hotel's main entrance is.
facts.excerpt: Arrival by car is via Kreuzstrasse, where the hotel’s main entrance is located.

facts.text: The larger lake-facing rooms have balconies with views of the Alps.
facts.excerpt: Splash out on one of the larger lake-facing ones, where the light bounces in off the water, and from which, if you step onto the balcony, you can admire the rippling silhouette of the not-too-distant Alps.

facts.text: La Muña is on the sixth floor, reached by a glass elevator from the lobby, with a tree-lined roof terrace.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the sixth floor and accessible directly via the glass elevator in the lobby, La Muña overlooks the city from its tree-lined roof terrace.

facts.text: La Muña serves Japanese-Peruvian dishes for sharing.
facts.excerpt: guests can enjoy a relaxed and festive atmosphere while sharing the Japanese Peruvian specialties

facts.text: La Muña has a 360-degree view of the historic center, with the lake and the Alps in the distance.
facts.excerpt: La Muña offers a unique 360° view of the historic center, with the lake and the Alps in the distance.

facts.text: La Muña's indoor room occupies the former attic beneath the hotel's dome.
facts.excerpt: Inside, it has taken over the former attic beneath the hotel’s spectacular dome.

facts.text: Skiffs and kayaks are mounted vertically inside the dome as a sculpture.
facts.excerpt: an extraordinary collection of skiffs and kayaks mounted vertically in the structure, forming a spectacular sculpture

facts.text: Stained-glass windows by Ara Starck guide the light through the dome.
facts.excerpt: In the dovecote, stained-glass windows created by Ara Starck accompany and guide the light through the dome.

facts.text: La Muña has 16 Gault-Millau points.
facts.excerpt: 16 GAULT-MILLAU POINTS

facts.text: Eden Kitchen's menu draws on Mediterranean-Italian culinary traditions.
facts.excerpt: A menu inspired by culinary traditions from Mediterranean-Italian cuisine

facts.text: Marco Ortolani is the Italian executive chef at Eden Kitchen.
facts.excerpt: As a young man, Marco Ortolani dreamed of discovering the world. Today, the Italian Executive Chef and his talented team bring its flavours to the Eden Kitchen

facts.text: Eden Kitchen dishes are prepared in an open show kitchen with seasonal ingredients, sourced locally whenever possible.
facts.excerpt: each one crafted in the open show kitchen using seasonal ingredients sourced locally whenever possible

facts.text: Eden Kitchen has one Michelin star and 17 Gault-Millau points.
facts.excerpt: 1 MICHELIN STAR, 17 GAULT-MILLAU POINTS & 50 TOP ITALY AWARD

facts.text: Eden Kitchen & Bar is on the ground floor, with large bay windows opening onto the outside.
facts.excerpt: On the ground floor, with its large bay windows opening onto the outside, Eden Kitchen & Bar promises to be an essential meeting point in Zurich.

facts.text: A multicolored stained-glass window by artist Ara Starck tints the light in Eden Kitchen & Bar.
facts.excerpt: gently tinted by the multicolored stained-glass window created by the artist Ara Starck

facts.text: The Eden Bar menu is divided equally between cocktails and mocktails.
facts.excerpt: the menu is deliberately divided equally between cocktails and mocktails

facts.text: Each Eden Bar cocktail has a non-alcoholic counterpart.
facts.excerpt: Each cocktail has a non-alcoholic counterpart, created with the same care and attention to detail.

facts.text: DJs play at the Eden Bar in the evening.
facts.excerpt: In the evening, our “Three Angels for La Réserve Zurich” set the mood from the DJ booth.

facts.text: The rooftop bar opens in summer.
facts.excerpt: In summer, our rooftop opens with a fine selection of snacks

facts.text: The rooftop bar has a 360-degree view of the historic center, the lake and the Alps.
facts.excerpt: with a breathtaking 360° panoramic view of the historic city center, the lake and the Alps in the distance

facts.text: A small fumoir sits off the ground floor behind an unmarked door.
facts.excerpt: There is a DJ booth and a sneaky little fumoir off to one side behind an unmarked door.

facts.text: Eden Kitchen serves a Sunday roast every Sunday.
facts.excerpt:
Sunday Roast at Eden Kitchen

EVERY SUNDAY FROM 3:00 TO 9:00 PM

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler readers named the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2025 and 2026.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2025, 2026
